<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening heading and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">On the eve of the fifth day of the week, Parshat Chayei Sarah,</t>
    <t s="2">the 20th of MarCheshvan</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that it is the birthday of the Rebbe Rashab.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">— the birthday of the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="1">(the Rebbe Rashab)</t>
    <t s="2">of blessed memory —</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section gives the year of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">the year 5741*</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
